Shortly after PlayStation's news, Xbox announced that it is expanding its own partnership with Kojima Productions by picking up the recently vacated publishing duties for Physint.

Related:Mark Cerny and Geoff Keighley launch university-affiliated fellowship program

As for the relationship between PlayStation and Kojima Productions, the company said that it "remains strong after three decades" following past partnerships on the Death Stranding series and that it looks forward to continued close collaboration in the future.

It's been announced overnight that Sony has decided to step away from Hideo Kojima's new PHYSINT game, which is described by the man himself as a "genre-defining action-espionage title", and Xbox Game Studios has stepped in to publish the project instead.
